newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunker prices steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunker prices steady in quiet trade.

text.p: ARA bunker prices were little changed on Monday amid quiet trade with many key players in London for oil industry functions, brokers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST was quoted at around $100/102 fob amid quiet trade, traders said.
"It's pretty dead with the States out and half the players here in London for IP week," one broker said.
Hamburg bunkers were little changed at $102/$103 fob, but demand was very thin.
The Mediterranean was fairly steady 380 CST quoted at $106/$108 in Augusta and at $103/$104 in Algeciras and $107/$108 in Las Palmas.
"It's very quiet start to the week," said an Italian-based broker. "Demand's pretty thin."
